records.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
records.short_quote: we split the inputs Q, K, V into blocks ... By scaling the output of each block by the right normalization factor before adding them up, we get the correct result at the end.
records.inspection_note: 實讀 GPU compute-bound/memory-bound 區分、tiling 的 normalization 合併與 backward recomputation，以及另加稀疏 mask 後跳過 zero blocks。支持分塊排程不必刪除注意力連結；不把論文 GPU 數字移作本課測得加速。

records.title: PyTorch activation checkpoint implementation and API docstring
records.short_quote: Activation checkpointing is a technique that trades compute for memory.
records.inspection_note: 實讀 trades compute for memory、前向不保留的 tensor 於 backward 按需要重新計算，以及 forward/backward invocation 不同可使梯度錯誤。支持「各有成本」，不承諾特定節省比例。
